_comment: WFR-68's subject artifact (WFO-LEDGER-COVERAGE). One entry per item in the plan's 'Reconciliation table' universe {166} u {167..376} (211 items total), transcribed via scripts/workflow_state.py's parse_reconciliation_table() against WORKFLOW_V2_PLAN.md at the plan revision current when this file was generated (see docs/ai-workflow/WORKFLOW_V2_PLAN.md, 'Revision 81 -- convergence' / 'Revision 82' for the authoritative table and the per-item resolution rule this transcription follows). 'evidence' is null for every entry: WFR-68 property (ii) (evidence-for-IMPLEMENTED, resolvable and executable at the pinned commit), the companion <work_item_id>-wf8c-evidence.json binding WF8c-owned items to their discharging test/function, and the WFO-LEDGER-COVERAGE verifier itself (properties (i)-(iv), the four adversarial arms) are not yet built -- this file is WF8c item (m)'s first, data-only increment. Not yet wired into COMPLETION_OBLIGATION_CONFORMANCE, so WFO-LEDGER-COVERAGE correctly stays UNKNOWN_OBLIGATION (fail-closed) until a later WF8c session binds the full verifier.
